text:
Alex: Cutting RC rc-47 from main at commit abc1234. Build tag 2026.03.17.rc-47 created and pinned to artifact registry. Requesting sign-off to promote during the 14:00-16:00 UTC change window. Small canary + staged traffic shift planned.

deploy-bot: Artifact pinned -> registry.redwood/serving:rc-47
Build metadata: 2026-03-17T10:12:03Z
Checks: unit ✅, integration ⚠️ (one flaky embedding timeout, retrying)
Note: auto-canary recommended by release policy.

Jen: Which integration failed? embedding client or auth?

Sam: saw a timeout on embedding client when sequence > 1024. Retried and it passed. QA is re-running the smoke suite now.

qa-bot: Smoke tests queued on staging (stable infra) — 5 tests pending. ETA ~6m.

Carol: Recommend canary 5% for 30m, then 25% for 20m, then 100% if stable. Keep burst capacity pinned to rc-46 as fallback during canary.

Alex: Rollback plan: revert traffic to rc-46, pin artifact rc-46, and abort rollout. Trigger conditions: error_rate > 2% over 15m OR p95 latency regresses > 2x. Oncall: tagging @Luis to monitor metrics and take action if needed.

Luis: Oncall acknowledged. I'll have dashboards up and ready, and I'll hold the rollback command if I see the thresholds. Add runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/rc-rollback

Alex: Deploy command (draft):
```
/deploy promote --artifact rc-47 --to prod --canary 5% --canary-duration 30m --followup 25%:20m --sli "error_rate<1%" --rollback-on "error_rate>2%:15m"
```

Jen: infra sign-off 👍 (build infra and autoscaling configs verified)

Sam: QA: smoke green on staging, no errors in embedding logs, perf within expected range — sign-off.

Carol: Security scan results: no new critical or high findings. sign-off.

Alex: Final call for promo. If no objections I'll trigger the deploy in 2m so canary lands inside the change window.

deploy-bot: Reminder: change window 14:00-16:00 UTC. Canary will be staged across us-west-2 then us-east-1. If any stage fails, the deploy will auto-pause.

Alex: /deploy promote rc-47 prod --canary=5 --canary-duration=30m --pause-on-error

deploy-bot: Promotion started: canary -> 5% traffic in us-west-2. Monitoring endpoints: https://observability.redwood/dashboards/rc-47-canary
If rollback triggered, traffic will revert to rc-46 automatically and an incident thread will be created. Good luck :rocket:

Luis: Monitoring now, ping me in thread if you see spike or anomalies.

Sam: will watch logs and tagged traces.

Alex: thanks all — will post updates after the 30m canary.
